payload.description: After the mailbox moved onto the Config door, default values live in two places: core/config-standard/mailbox.yaml and packages/mailbox/contracts/limits.v1.json, kept equal by a host test. Make the effective snapshot section authoritative at runtime, so that a missing key is a named error, and make the crate tests read the bundled standard or a fixture taken from it. Then retire the contract defaults and the equality test. Open points: naming the exact missing key without a key list (serde_path_to_error or similar); the core crate's serde-only dependency rule; the frozen v7 measurement harness reads the contract by sha256; p95TargetMs and per-key metadata exist only in the contract. Asked for by CFG in its review of the mailbox config land.
payload.title: Mailbox reads its defaults only from the Config standard
payload.verify: cargo test -p fgos-mailbox -p fgos-mailbox-core and the mailbox host tests pass with limits.v1.json carrying no default values
